name: Esperanto
variety: the norm of the Fundamento and of the Academy of Esperanto
sources: Zamenhof, L. L. (1905). Fundamento de Esperanto.
Wennergren, Bertilo (2005). Plena Manlibro de Esperanta Gramatiko.
contrasts: five vowels with no length contrast
a voiceless velar fricative beside h
affricates c, ĉ, ĝ beside the fricatives
allophony: r is a tap or a trill, by the speaker
n before a velar may be velar, and need not be

stress.rule: Stress falls on the syllable before the last of every word of more than one syllable.
stress.cues: length and pitch of the stressed vowel

rhythm.notes: No measurement exists: the class is what the design of the language implies.

intonation.declarative: not prescribed; speakers carry over the fall of their own languages
intonation.yes_no_question: rising at the end by the practice of most speakers; questions begin with ĉu
intonation.accent_shape: not prescribed; higher pitch on the stressed syllable is the usual practice
intonation.notes: The language has no native speakers whose melody could be described; what is given is the practice of its users.

notes: Every letter has one sound and every vowel is said in full.
